simplified: Type 2 diabetes is a type of diabetes that makes your blood sugar high. It happens when your body can't use insulin well and sometimes doesn't make enough. Long-term, it can cause heart problems, strokes, eye problems that might make you go blind, and weak legs that might need amputations.
